title.en: Meta Releases Muse Spark 1.3 for Agentic Coding and Long-Thread Work
title.zhHans: Meta 发布用于智能体编程与长线程工作的 Muse Spark 1.3

searchSummary.en: Meta released Muse Spark 1.3 on September 2, 2026. Artificial Analysis listed the public xhigh variant at 61 on its Intelligence Index; Meta described incremental agentic and coding improvements.
searchSummary.zhHans: Meta 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日发布 Muse Spark 1.3。Artificial Analysis 将公开的 xhigh 变体列为智能指数 61 分；Meta 描述了智能体与编程能力的增量改善。

summary.en: Meta released Muse Spark 1.3 in Muse Code and the Meta Model API on September 2, 2026. Artificial Analysis reported a score of 61 for the public xhigh variant and 62 for a higher configuration described as limited preview. Meta reported fewer tool calls and fewer tokens in internal engineering comparisons with version 1.2. This is a product iteration, not evidence of a durable structural industry shift.
summary.zhHans: Meta 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日在 Muse Code 与 Meta Model API 中发布 Muse Spark 1.3。Artificial Analysis 报告公开 xhigh 变体为 61 分，受限预览的较高配置为 62 分。Meta 在内部工程比较中报告，相比 1.2 版本工具调用和 token 消耗有所减少。这是一次产品迭代，而非持久行业结构变化的证据。

narrative.en: Meta says the model better sustains long-horizon work, follows complex instructions, and uses about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens in its engineering comparisons. Artificial Analysis provides an independent index score, but the highest-scoring configuration remains constrained while Meta completes safety testing. The evidence supports an L1 record of a competitive model update; it does not support L2-style claims of a new industry direction or an irreversible capability break.
narrative.zhHans: Meta 称该模型更能维持长程工作、遵循复杂指令，并在其工程比较中少用约 20% 的工具调用和 25% 的 token。Artificial Analysis 提供独立指数分数，但最高分配置仍受限，Meta 正在完成安全测试。证据支持将其作为一项有竞争力的模型更新记录为 L1；不支持将其写成新的行业方向或不可逆的能力断裂等 L2 式主张。

description.en: Provides an incremental released update for long-thread agentic and coding tasks, with mixed independent and vendor evaluation evidence.
description.zhHans: 为长线程智能体与编程任务提供一次增量发布更新，评估证据由独立与厂商材料共同构成。

description.en: Artificial Analysis reported a lower task-cost position among high-index models; broader API pricing effects remain uncertain.
description.zhHans: Artificial Analysis 报告其在高指数模型中具有较低任务成本位置；更广泛的 API 定价影响仍不确定。

text.en: Meta released Muse Spark 1.3 on September 2, 2026; Artificial Analysis listed xhigh at 61 and a limited-preview higher configuration at 62.
text.zhHans: Meta 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日发布 Muse Spark 1.3；Artificial Analysis 将 xhigh 列为 61 分，并将受限预览的较高配置列为 62 分。

text.en: Meta reported improvements in long-thread instruction following and lower tool and token use relative to version 1.2; the independent index does not independently validate every reported improvement.
text.zhHans: Meta 报告，相比 1.2 版本，该模型在长线程指令遵循、工具调用和 token 消耗方面有所改善；独立指数并未独立验证每项所报告提升。

text.en: The highest-scoring configuration remains restricted while Meta completes additional safety testing.
text.zhHans: 最高分配置仍处于受限状态，Meta 正在完成额外安全测试。

editorial.reviewNotes: Confirmed L1 calibration: this is an incremental product release with a restricted highest-scoring configuration, not a structural turning point.

changeLog.summary: Completed pre-publication factual-boundary, provenance, and evidence-grade review.
